name: dia-text-reveal
title: Dia Text Reveal
description: A heading whose trailing word changes between phrases while a multicoloured band sweeps across it, revealing each new word with a brief rainbow shine.
use: A rotating tagline word should get a flash of colour each time it appears.
avoid: Quiet editorial pages; the repeated colour sweep is loud and draws the eye.
a11y: Reduced-motion is honoured by skipping the sweep, but the changing word is not announced to screen readers. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: respected)
looks: The words Crafted with in bold white, followed by a single word on the same line. While a word appears, its letters are painted by a travelling band of pink, red, amber, lilac and blue.
behaves: A gradient band slides left to right over the trailing word, uncovering it in colour; once past, the word rests in plain white, then fades out and the next phrase is revealed the same way.
customise: Pass text as a string or array and set colors, textColor, duration, delay, repeat and fixedWidth; the band width and sweep easing are fixed in the source.
weight: light: One animated span with a moving CSS gradient; only the word width is tweened.
demo: The heading Crafted with precision, then purpose, then passion.
issues: Between phrases the changing word disappears completely, leaving an empty gap beside the heading.
polishWhy: A lively, well-timed colour sweep; the blank gap between words is a little jarring.
